summary: Iteration 2 frontend-only E2E testing of SAP WM Transfer Order Processor. All 13 acceptance criteria pass: header renders, 17 records badge, 20 numeric cards + Mixed card, correct filter logic (Card 1 -> 5330157, Card 2 -> 0 TOs, Card 3 -> 5330147, Mixed -> 5330146 with row spread 07/08/10/17), 2-column vs 3-column table toggle for Mixed, batch size switching (5 -> 10 produces 11 cards), search filter, clear filter, reset data, Copy TO to SAP produces 12 newline-separated unique TOs on clipboard. No React console errors or page errors observed. Refactors (processDataset extracted, IIFE table caption) are functioning correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: handleFileUpload only supports CSV parsing (readAsText) even though the UI/badge advertises XLSX support. Uploading a real .xlsx will produce garbled parsing. Consider using a library like xlsx/SheetJS or update UI copy to say CSV only.
CSV parser uses naive line.split(',') which breaks on quoted values containing commas. Low risk for SAP TO data but worth noting.
App.js is ~910 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold in code-review guidelines. Consider splitting card grid, table, and upload/config sections into subcomponents.
seed_data_creation: None — used INITIAL_RAW_DATA mock in App.js
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 13 acceptance criteria from iteration 2 pass. Numeric text extraction from table cells concatenates cell values (e.g. row index+TO -> '15330157'); assertions use substring 'in' check. Clipboard permissions must be granted in Playwright to test copy button. Mixed card testid is 'card-batch-mixed'. Numeric cards are 'card-batch-1' .. 'card-batch-20' with batchSize=5 and maxRow=98.
